I replied to Ilse in a thread under their message in #north-random. I confirmed the 2026 Quarrendon Freight Lines renewal is 100 seats and said I'd use that figure from now on.

Ilse said no action was needed, so I didn't change anything else. My reply doesn't mention the wrong number from #north-team, because #north-random may include people who can't see that channel. A seat count isn't a finance figure, so posting it here was fine.
